action_brackets.instruction: Set the speed control to approximately 3 RPM while keeping the motor OFF. Do not switch it on yet. When finished, enter exactly: RPM3_READY
Switch the motor ON now. Immediately after switching it on, enter exactly: LOW_ON
Switch the motor OFF now. Immediately after switching it off, enter exactly: LOW_OFF
Set the speed control to approximately 8 RPM while keeping the motor OFF. When finished, enter exactly: RPM8_READY
Switch the motor ON now. Immediately after switching it on, enter exactly: MEDIUM_ON
Switch the motor OFF now. Immediately after switching it off, enter exactly: MEDIUM_OFF
Confirm that operating this non-rigid rotating arm at approximately 15 RPM is mechanically safe. If safe, enter exactly: RPM15_SAFE. If not safe, enter exactly: RPM15_UNSAFE
Set approximately 15 RPM while keeping the motor OFF. When finished, enter exactly: RPM15_READY
Switch the motor ON now. Immediately after switching it on, enter exactly: HIGH_ON
Switch the motor OFF now. Immediately after switching it off, enter exactly: HIGH_OFF
Set approximately 8 RPM while keeping the motor OFF. When finished, enter exactly: SHORT_RPM8_READY
Cycle 1: switch the motor ON now. Immediately after switching it on, enter exactly: CYCLE_1_ON
Cycle 1: switch the motor OFF now. Immediately after switching it off, enter exactly: CYCLE_1_OFF
Cycle 2: switch the motor ON now. Immediately after switching it on, enter exactly: CYCLE_2_ON
Cycle 2: switch the motor OFF now. Immediately after switching it off, enter exactly: CYCLE_2_OFF
